name: @pinpoint/data
comment: Reads and writes of trip data, shared by both apps. Same shape as @pinpoint/auth: every function takes an already-constructed client and returns a discriminated result rather than throwing, so this package never touches cookies, secure storage, or anything else that resolves on only one platform. Adding a runtime dependency beyond the workspace packages is a signal the code belongs in an app instead — see openspec/specs/monorepo-structure.
